In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the design of experiments is a scientific methodology for the planning, implementation, and evaluation of an experiment, in order to obtain the most precise and objective information about the system under study. 3 3.
DOE is the process of planning and conducting experiments to obtain information about factors affecting a process or product.
A DOE is a structured and organized plan to perform experiments in order to determine how the variation of the independent experimental variables (factors) influence the measured results (responses).
